dcs_requirements: Exactly one GW5A DCS, FALLING, SELFORCE0, onehot-or-zero select
Both generated clocks present on the same resolved DCS output, each with its correct master
Dedicated clock routing and both-mode setup/hold/minimum pulse width; no generic data clock mux
gray_gate: Resolve every surviving bit, prove source-to-first-stage arrival and bus skew below20ns, list optimized bits explicitly. Source Gray registers and second-stage timing must remain. No whole-clock-group exception may override these paths.
snapshot_gate: Resolve snapshot_hold to snapshot_payload_meta, bound all surviving payload bits20ns; second payload stage and ACK/request stages remain timed. Verify held-data-before-ACK and one outstanding request in netlist and simulation.
configuration_gate: Resolve transaction pending_epoch/pending_44k1 to serializer epoch/mode_44k1 and verify20ns bound. The one-time configuration sample occurs only after full target qualification plus three true local-release edges; prove staging stability over this window. Do not interpret changed staged tags as the still-draining old stream.
reset_chains: power_on_count/power_ready: external assertion, registered release after1024 reference cycles
audio_domain/reset_release: three selected edges; assertion independent of stopped source
quiesce/resume and source snapshot registers: local audio reset
return ACK/payload registers:50MHz global assertion, explicit flush invalidation
reset_gate: Inspect every async assert path and release endpoint. Report setup/hold/recovery/removal and minimum pulse width separately for both selected modes. Any necessary exception for first reset synchronizer cells must be individually justified and leave released reset-to-consumer checks intact; none is silently inserted by prepare.
io_gate: Audited existing3.3V pins only; output SMUTE constant1 and PCM0. External DAC setup/hold,384fs recognition and analog output are NOT accepted by this digital experiment.
unsupported_constraint_policy: Stop on missing SDK dual-master support, ignored clock, zero-match object, dropped bound or unsupported report syntax. Do not relax periods, false-path the audio domain, or remove diagnostic/features to make it pass.
